$comment: Environment configuration knob registry. Canonical source of the knob inventory; metadata is curated, membership is machine-verified by scripts/check_config_knobs.py.

ANDROID_HOME.description: External tooling location, not a tuning knob: the Android SDK root that Android's own tooling defines. android/native/check_proot.py, like build-proot.sh, runs llvm-readelf from the NDK pinned in android/native/pins.env at $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<NDK_VERSION> and refuses to run while it is unset; there is no default. Build-time only: the server never reads it.

ARTIFACTS_ENABLED.description: Existing artifacts enabled environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

CACHE_EXTENDED_TTL.description: Opt-in 1h TTL on the Claude system+tools cache breakpoints plus the extended-cache-ttl beta header; the conversation tail stays 5m. '1' enables, any other set value disables, unset defers to data/config/features.json cache_extended_ttl, default off. Latched per task. Measured net-negative on the Sankuai route: docs/LLM_COST_OPTIMIZATION.md, Stable-head cache TTL.

CURL_CA_BUNDLE.description: Fallback CA bundle for the search HTTP/2 client when REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE is absent; applies to destination and HTTPS proxy TLS.

DEBUG_MODE.description: Existing debug mode environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

DOUBAO_MODEL.description: Existing doubao model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

EDITBENCH_CC_STRINGS.description: Path to a strings dump of the pinned Claude Code 2.1.207 binary, used only by the offline edit-benchmark comparison arm. Unset leaves that arm unavailable; the server never reads it. Existing read-only build/benchmark input, not a product tuning setting.

EDITBENCH_CODEX_DIR.description: Path to a read-only vendored Codex checkout used by the offline edit-benchmark arm and its patch verifier. Unset leaves that arm unavailable; build/benchmark-time only, never a server runtime dependency or new checkout selector.

EDITBENCH_TOFU_WORKTREE.description: Existing explicit path to a read-only Tofu worktree that the offline edit benchmark runs its oracle and write arms against; run_bench refuses missing targets instead of guessing a source checkout. Benchmark-time only, the server never reads it.

FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Existing fallback model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

GEMINI_FLASH_PREVIEW_MODEL.description: Existing gemini flash preview model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Existing gemini model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

GITHUB_EVENT_NAME.description: GitHub Actions-provided event name used by the existing CI qualification selector; schedule, manual and tag events require full qualification. Set by the runner, never by the application; not a product tuning setting.

GITHUB_EVENT_PATH.description: GitHub Actions-provided event JSON file read by the existing qualification selector to resolve the push or pull-request comparison revision; unavailable history requires full qualification. Set by the runner, never by the application.

GITHUB_OUTPUT.description: GitHub Actions-provided step-output file receiving the existing qualification profile and comparison revision identifiers. Set by the runner, never by the application; contains no repository credential values.

IMAGE_GEN_MODEL.description: Existing image gen model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

JAVA_HOME.description: External JDK tooling location for real local keystore/signing verification; an unset value uses java/keytool on PATH. Android and the source-launch certificate guard require JDK 17. This is not a runtime capacity/tuning setting.

LOGNAME.description: POSIX login-name fallback used with USER for diagnostic attribution of an operator-initiated restart/stop in audited approval provenance. Unset leaves the operator name empty; never authentication or authorization evidence.

MINIMAX_MODEL.description: Existing minimax model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

MTSSO_AUTH_MODE.description: Existing MTSSO authentication selection: auto (default), official or legacy; other values refuse configuration.

MTSSO_ENV.description: Existing MTSSO environment fallback when no explicit environment is supplied; defaults to PROD and participates in the owner/environment authentication cache key.

MTSSO_NODE_EXECUTABLE.description: Authoritative Node executable override for the official MTSSO agent bridge; automatic selection is used only without this override.

MTSSO_OFFICIAL_EXECUTABLE.description: Existing executable override for the official MTSSO authentication command.

MTSSO_SESSION_SDK.description: Existing absolute path to the installed DataFE shared SSO auth module. An explicitly configured missing or relative path is rejected; otherwise discovery uses locally installed CLI locations without network installation.

MTSSO_SESSION_TOKEN_FILE.description: Existing absolute path to a shared SSO session file. Relative paths are rejected; when unset, the session owner resolves the existing MLP or LLM CLI token file in the user home.

MTSSO_SHARED_SESSION.description: Existing shared SSO selection: value 1 explicitly selects shared authentication even with incomplete configuration. Otherwise local SDK and usable same-identity session evidence govern automatic selection.

OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.description: Operator override for Ollama parallel allocation, captured in the local hardware snapshot. When unset, known dense GGUF layouts derive parallelism from observed resources; other layouts start lean. Literal values pass to Ollama for validation.

OPTIMIZER_ENABLED.description: Existing optimizer enabled environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

PREFETCH_GATE_ENABLED.description: Existing prefetch gate enabled environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/search/search_bridge.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

QWEN_MODEL.description: Existing qwen model environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE.description: Optional CA bundle used by the search HTTP/2 client for destination TLS and HTTPS proxy TLS. Takes precedence over CURL_CA_BUNDLE.

ROOTLESS_VM_BASE_DISK.description: Existing rootless vm base disk environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in evaluations/swebench/cli.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

ROOTLESS_VM_IMAGE_STORE.description: Existing rootless vm image store environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in evaluations/swebench/cli.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

ROOTLESS_VM_QEMU_IMG.description: Existing rootless vm qemu img environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in evaluations/swebench/cli.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

SCHEDULER_ALLOW_CODE_EXEC.description: Existing scheduler allow code exec environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/__init__.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

SCROLL_STABILITY_OUT.description: Optional output directory for conversation scroll-stability browser evidence (sampled frames and summaries); defaults to the test tmp_path.

TB_NATIVE_PI_RUNTIME.description: Absolute path to an extracted runtime tree produced by python -m evaluations.pi_contract build-runtime. When set, the native Pi relay-stub test executes that pinned runtime; when unset, the offline helper and contract tests still run and the live-runtime test skips.

TOFUDB_EMBEDDED_LIB.description: Embedded TofuDB shared-library path for projection relocation integration checks; defaults beside the native test binary.

TOFUDB_EXPECTED_SHA256.description: Operator/test pin of the expected TofuDB engine binary SHA-256; verified before engine launch.

TOFUDB_PRE_FRONTIER_BIN.description: Optional frozen pre-frontier executable for the explicit old-writer downgrade regression. Unset skips that test; never selects the application storage engine.

TOFUDB_REQUIRE_FRESH_ENGINE.description: Existing tofudb require fresh engine environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/storage/supervisor.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFUDB_TEST_BINARY.description: Test-only path to the private source-matched tofu-db executable; never selects the application service.

TOFUDB_TEST_LIBRARY.description: Test-only path to the matching private libtofu_db.so for abrupt process-loss and reopen verification.

TOFUDB_TEST_SOURCE.description: Test-only expected SHA-256 engine source identity; SIGKILL/reopen fixtures refuse mismatched artifacts.

TOFUDB_TRANSPORT.description: Native TofuDB authority transport: auto (default; resolves at launch from the authority volume class — embedded everywhere except observed network mounts, where the engine's Normal durability tier requires the daemon; classifier in lib/storage/volume_class.py mirrors packages/tofu-db/src/resource_probe.rs), daemon (supervised tofu-db serve child over loopback storage.v2), or embedded (same engine in-process via libtofu_db.so). A transport choice, never a second authority; invalid values fail closed.

TOFU_AGENT_RUN_DELEGATE_MODE.description: Default for `tofu-agent run --delegate-mode`: 1, true or yes runs the headless agent in Delegate Mode, where the root only orchestrates and spawn_agents workers do every read, search, command and edit (lib/tasks_pkg/delegate_mode.py; docs/TASK_EXECUTION_MODES.md, "Delegate Mode"). Requires swarm tools; unset or any other value keeps the ordinary surface.

TOFU_AGENT_RUN_THINKING.description: Existing standalone agent run reasoning-depth input, equivalent to --thinking and validated against the shared THINKING_DEPTHS contract. Omitted leaves the model-route default; no new runtime knob is introduced here.

TOFU_AGENT_WORKERS.description: Cataloged process resource budget (count); personal and distributed launch defaults are owned by contracts/resource_policy_v1.json. Explicit overrides, probe fallback and finite consumer bounds resolve through runtime_guards.resolve_resource_budget. Changes require process restart.

TOFU_ANDROID_APK_PATH.description: Operator-verified local APK path served by authenticated mobile download routes. No per-request signature/manifest inspection; no browser credential is exported into its URL or QR.

TOFU_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.description: Required private release keystore password, injected through the build environment/CI secret. Never enters command arguments, repository files or logs.

TOFU_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH.description: Required operator-owned private release keystore. Relative paths resolve against android/app; Gradle passes the canonical absolute file to the JDK guard. CI stages an owner-only absolute path. Debug builds need no private signing values.

TOFU_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS.description: Private release keystore alias. All signing values are required; the public androiddebugkey alias is rejected case-insensitively, and the JDK guard verifies the real private-key entry.

TOFU_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD.description: Required private release key password, injected through the build environment/CI secret. Never enters command arguments, repository files or logs.

TOFU_ANDROID_SIGNER_SHA256.description: Required SHA-256 release certificate pin. JDK keystore admission and apksigner output must identify the same single non-debug certificate; mismatches refuse publication.

TOFU_BUDGET_VITE_URL_ASSET_KIB.description: Existing budget vite url asset kib environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in scripts/frontend_budget.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CGROUP_POLL_SEC.description: Existing cgroup poll sec environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/cgroup_guard.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CGROUP_RELIEF_PCT.description: Existing cgroup relief pct environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/cgroup_guard.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CGROUP_WARN_PCT.description: Existing cgroup warn pct environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/cgroup_guard.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CHAT_TASK_TERMINAL_TTL_SECONDS.description: Cataloged process resource budget (seconds); personal and distributed launch defaults are owned by contracts/resource_policy_v1.json. Explicit overrides, probe fallback and finite consumer bounds resolve through runtime_guards.resolve_resource_budget. Changes require process restart.

TOFU_CHECKPOINT_SQL_TEST_LIBRARY.description: Test-only native SQL checkpoint library path propagated into owned recovery subprocesses; paired with TOFU_CHECKPOINT_SQL_TEST_SHA256 for exact image verification, without selecting the application storage backend.

TOFU_CHECKPOINT_SQL_TEST_SHA256.description: Test-only SHA-256 pin for TOFU_CHECKPOINT_SQL_TEST_LIBRARY, checked before native SQL checkpoint recovery subprocesses acquire their private test authority.

TOFU_CLIENT_REPORTS_DIR.description: Client diagnostic report segment directory override; defaults to client_reports under the configured data root.

TOFU_CMD_INTERRUPT_GRACE_SECS.description: Seconds the shared liveness judge lets a watchdog interrupt of one silent foreground run_command wait for that command's read loop before the agent (root or child) counts as wedged. Default 120.

TOFU_CODEX_01491_BINARY.description: Existing codex 01491 binary environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in evaluations/swebench/cli.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CODEX_NATIVE_STARTUP_MAX_SECONDS.description: Ceiling for the learned native Codex app-server cold startup (spawn+initialize) budget; default 30 seconds, accepted 4-300 seconds; invalid values warn once and keep the default.

TOFU_CODEX_SHARED_LOGIN.description: Personal deployments borrow an owner-bound local/desktop Codex login without importing refresh tokens; 0 disables sharing.

TOFU_COMMAND_SNAPSHOT_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Cataloged process resource budget (count); personal and distributed launch defaults are owned by contracts/resource_policy_v1.json. Explicit overrides, probe fallback and finite consumer bounds resolve through runtime_guards.resolve_resource_budget. Changes require process restart.

TOFU_COMMAND_SNAPSHOT_MAX_SECONDS.description: Cataloged process resource budget (seconds); personal and distributed launch defaults are owned by contracts/resource_policy_v1.json. Explicit overrides, probe fallback and finite consumer bounds resolve through runtime_guards.resolve_resource_budget. Changes require process restart.

TOFU_CONTENT_SHADOW.description: Disable demand-filled indexed-search content copies with 0/false/off; source searches remain complete. See docs/INDEX_FASTPATH.md.

TOFU_CONTENT_SHADOW_DIR.description: Optional absolute private POSIX directory for reconstructible search bytes; empty uses measured local index placement.

TOFU_CONTENT_SHADOW_GLOBAL_MAX_BYTES.description: Aggregate content-cache retention bytes, default 4 GiB; leased readers and source data are protected.

TOFU_CONTENT_SHADOW_MAX_FILE_BYTES.description: Maximum disposable content copy per file, default 8 MiB. Oversized source files remain live search candidates.

TOFU_CONTENT_SHADOW_ROOT_MAX_BYTES.description: Per-project content-cache retention bytes including allocation and metadata, default 1 GiB; source data is never evicted.

TOFU_CONTENT_SHADOW_ROOT_MAX_FILES.description: Per-project retained content-copy count, default 200000; eviction only, never search admission.

TOFU_CONTEXT_COMPILER_OUTPUT.description: Destination path for the standalone context compiler benchmark JSON report.

TOFU_CONVERSATION_SYNC_PRUNE_INTERVAL.description: Existing conversation sync prune interval environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/tasks_pkg/event_log.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CONVERSATION_SYNC_PRUNE_MAX_ROWS.description: Existing conversation sync prune max rows environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/tasks_pkg/event_log.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CONVERSATION_SYNC_REPLAY_TTL_DAYS.description: Existing conversation sync replay ttl days environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/tasks_pkg/event_log.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_CONV_STICKY_HOLD.description: Opt-in waiting for a cooled warm key instead of selecting a healthy eligible alternative; default off.

TOFU_DB_FASTPATH.description: off, auto (default) or on. Automatic native fastpath selection for the whole-authority local front: auto nominates a proven-persistent local base that fits the measured corpus (bytes and inodes) with growth room and twice its per-block publication cost inside half the seed budget, then the engine admits it on a 3x fsync or 3x metadata win within a 2x fsync bound; on skips the Python speed prediction and leaves admission to the engine probe. off never relocates.

TOFU_DB_FASTPATH_ADMISSION.description: required or auto. Set by the supervisor for an automatic selection only: a typed pre-relocation refusal (volume, memory, speedup, capacity, inode, corpus size, stale preparation) then serves the classic authority and records the reason, while a fenced, lineage or integrity error still fails the launch. An explicit TOFU_DB_FASTPATH_DIR always runs required.

TOFU_DB_FASTPATH_DIR.description: Explicit persistent-local base for the native whole-authority fastpath; implies required engine admission and daemon transport. Setup, capacity governance and the planned exit are in docs/TOFUDB_FASTPATH.md.

TOFU_DB_FASTPATH_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS.description: Explicit shadow replication cadence in milliseconds (1000..3600000) for the native fastpath; requires TOFU_DB_FASTPATH_DIR. The default derives from twice the measured initial snapshot cost.

TOFU_DB_REQUEST_PROFILE_EVERY.description: Opt-in native request profiler: 0/unset disables; positive N samples every Nth dispatch. Rust reads once per process; bounded anonymous metrics, separate embedded queue time. Benchmark records requested launch value.

TOFU_ENABLE_PYMUPDF_LAYOUT.description: Existing enable pymupdf layout environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in runtime_guards.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_EVENT_LEGACY_RECOVERY_ROWS.description: Existing event legacy recovery rows environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/tasks_pkg/event_log.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_EXPORT_API_URL.description: Origin of the running application's API from which an internal export reads the current model-routing authority and audited credential reveals. Unset uses http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (default port 15000). Only http(s) on 127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost is accepted; requests use no proxy and follow no redirect.

TOFU_FACT_CONSUMER_MEASURE_OUTPUT.description: Optional output directory for working-fact consumer measurements; defaults to the test-owned temporary directory.

TOFU_FIND_FASTPATH_DEADLINE_S.description: Existing find fastpath deadline s environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/project_mod/shell_find.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_GREP_TIMEOUT_COOLDOWN_S.description: Existing grep timeout cooldown s environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/project_mod/grep_timeout_circuit.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_HARNESS_GRAPH_BINARY.description: Opt-in test-only path to the native graph prototype executable for cross-backend and process-crash contract verification; absence skips the external prototype check and does not change application authority.

TOFU_HISTORY_BASE_MS.description: Existing history base ms environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in tests/visual/test_visual_history_paging_latency.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_HISTORY_PER_MIB_MS.description: Existing history per mib ms environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in tests/visual/test_visual_history_paging_latency.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_HISTORY_READER_PX_PER_S.description: Existing history reader px per s environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in tests/visual/test_visual_history_paging_latency.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_HTTP_POOL_MAX_CONNECTIONS.description: Existing http pool max connections environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/http_transport/client.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_HTTP_POOL_MAX_KEEPALIVE.description: Existing http pool max keepalive environment override, read through the local configuration adapter in lib/http_transport/client.py; defaults and validation remain owned there.

TOFU_HTTP_WRITE_STALL_SECS.description: Seconds without observed buffer drain or TCP acknowledgement progress before resetting a peer; default 300, range 1–86400; renews during HTTP/WebSocket writes and normal close, independently of explicit shutdown grace and durable storage budgets.

TOFU_INCREMENTAL_TRANSLATE_PREVIEW_DEADL.description: Cataloged process resource budget (seconds); personal and distributed launch defaults are owned by contracts/resource_policy_v1.json. TOFU_INDEX_FASTPATH.description: Reconstructible file and native search index placement: auto (default) selects a private local volume only after a measured metadata speedup of at least 3x; off retains data-volume indexes; on skips speed comparison. TOFU_LOCAL_DIR overrides candidates; restart applies placement changes.

TOFU_UPDATE_BRANCH.description: Branch the in-app updater checks and fast-forwards from. Unset or empty, a git checkout follows its current branch's upstream (branch.<name>.merge), and main only when HEAD is detached or the branch tracks nothing. Check and apply always use the same resolved branch.

TOFU_UPDATE_REMOTE.description: Git remote (name or URL) the in-app updater checks and pulls from. Unset or empty, a git checkout follows its current branch's upstream (branch.<name>.remote), and origin only when HEAD is detached or the branch tracks nothing. A remote other than the official GitHub repository is checked by fetching it and reading VERSION.

TOFU_UPDATE_REPO.description: GitHub owner/repo whose release tags are the update check for the official remote and for non-git installs (which also download its release tarballs); default rangehow/ToFu. Set explicitly, a git checkout keeps this tags check whatever its upstream remote is. Read at import for the GitHub API URLs.

TOFU_VISUAL_STATIC_ROOT.description: Read-only prebuilt frontend static artifact root for isolated browser verification; defaults to this checkout static directory.

TOFU_WORKSPACE_MODE.description: Explicit direct or isolated workspace execution policy; overrides repository-local tofu.workspaceMode. Absence defaults to direct execution. Invalid values fail closed; this setting never enables automatic commits or changes publication refs.

TOFU_WORKSPACE_TOOL_WAIT_SECONDS.description: Optional explicit cancellable wait for Tofu's own task-bound workspace lease acquisitions (dependency setup, stable integration snapshots); model tool calls take no workspace lease. Unset or empty waits until acquisition; nonnegative finite values are exact, zero is fail-fast, with no 600-second clamp. Low-level omitted lease timeouts remain fail-fast.

XDG_CONFIG_HOME.description: Linux per-user configuration root for the Agent login-startup entry; absolute paths only, default ~/.config. No credentials are stored in the startup entry.

compaction.summaryBudgetSeconds.description: Legacy values are ignored, including zero and positive values. Summary completion has no wall-clock deadline; cancellation and provider transport failures still apply. Elapsed duration is telemetry, never permission to adopt incomplete output or discard its source.

compaction.summaryMaxCostUsd.description: Owner decision 2026-11-02: summaries have no cost ceiling, because a fixed dollar bound grows wrong as context grows and silently returns large summaries to the owner's subscription. Legacy values, including zero and invalid values, are ignored. Spend stays bounded by known prices: a paid main that can serve the summary admits only strictly cheaper paid routes.

qualification.caller: Existing API receipts return an execution providerId; requestOwned receipts instead carry stable routeIdentity and a billing providerId, minted into a private execution pin at dispatch. Use strict_model=True and at most two 429 attempts; verify complete output and existing adoption checks. Bounded selectionBasis records optional exact AA, maintained declared evidence, or routing admission with a null score; never invented measured capability or cash savings. Under ranking paid_api_then_resource_cost_aa, resourceTier 0 is paid API and 1 is owner resource. Main task model/config is never mutated.
qualification.capacity: Every picker-reachable slot must have declared context/output capacity including full input plus requested output, intersected with learned context limits.
qualification.executionScope: All native main routes consider enabled authorized same-owner/tenant text Offerings and every usable deployment/credential witness through the shared candidate compiler. Main provider/family, execution-slot membership and optional benchmark/profile coverage never restrict native eligibility. Mint only the selected witness in a private request-owned group; no main-model mutation. Legacy callers without native authority retain same-pin API compatibility.
qualification.pricing: Paid candidates use token-weighted per-million input/output/cache rates from the Offering's own declared USD/CNY rate card at the selected prompt tier, else the model's maintained price through the verified lookup shared with summary settlement and main-route economics; zero speculative cache reads and a conservative cold-cache write reserve. A fitting paid main's known price (same resolution) requires strictly lower projected alternate cost, and an unknown fitting main price admits no paid alternate; subscription mains and paid mains that cannot fit compare no price. There is no cost ceiling. Subscription resource/reference proxies never establish marginal cash cost. Unknown, invalid or time-dependent prices never mean free, and an invalid declared card never falls back to the model price.
qualification.qualityProxy: Confirmed identity and compiler-authorized text capability establish eligibility. Fresh exact-model AA and maintained declarations are optional ranking evidence, not allowlists. Missing evidence stays unknown (routing_admission, null score), never invented AA or variant inheritance. Cached routing scores own freshness with no inline fetch. Text capability is not a measured summary-fidelity guarantee; complete-output adoption checks remain mandatory.
qualification.ranking: Parent-independent billing classes: known-price organization-billed paid API first, authorized subscription/OAuth/local owner resources second. A paid main whose declared capacity fits the summary is itself the paid baseline, so owner resources are skipped for it; they stay eligible for subscription mains and paid mains that cannot fit. Within a class prefer projected paid cost or known resource-reference proxy, then known exact AA descending, declared lightness and stable provider/offering/deployment/credential identity. Missing proxies and scores do not disqualify resource candidates. Paid-to-paid requires strict savings against a known best reachable main price when that main can serve the summary. Class order is billing policy, not free subscription cash. Legacy groups retain worst reachable cost and weakest AA. No price-band tolerance.
qualification.safety: Explicit main and disableModelFallback prohibit auxiliary discovery. Credential kinds oauth, subscription and local_identity express resource access; subscription may carry an API-key envelope. Plain api_key is not proof of either subscription entitlement or free usage, and provider names never establish billing. Paid quotes need a known price (Offering rate card, else maintained model price); unknown paid prices fail closed and no cost ceiling applies. Resource marginal cash cost remains unknown. Mint only at dispatch; bind stable owner/tenant/revision and provider/access/offering/deployment/connection/credential identity, revalidate quote, restore parent pin and dispose credentials on every exit.

alternativesRejected: Requiring the main model's ordinal quality tier despite exact AA evidence
Owner subscription/local resources before organization-billed paid APIs
Treating Offerings without a request-name rate card as unpriced when their model has a maintained price
Any fixed or configurable summary cost ceiling, which grows wrong with context size
Requiring subscription-main paid alternates to beat the subscription model's list price
Unbounded paid alternates for a fitting main whose price stays unknown
rationale.decision: Compression considers every compiler-authorized enabled same-owner/tenant text route, independently of the main provider/family or optional AA/profile coverage. Owner decision 2026-11-02: known-price organization-billed paid APIs rank before the owner's subscription/OAuth/local resources, which remain a fallback and are skipped for a paid main that fits the summary. A route without its own request-name rate card is priced at its model's maintained price, and summaries have no cost ceiling. Projected paid cost or maintained resource-reference cost ranks within each class, then exact AA, declared lightness and stable identity. A paid main that can serve the summary admits only paid routes strictly cheaper than its known price, and none when its price stays unknown; other mains admit the cheapest known-price paid route. All evidence is proxy evidence, never measured fidelity, speed or subscription cash cost. Explicit main and disableModelFallback retain main.
rationale.problem: Auxiliary summaries may be cheaper without changing the main task model or granting new route permissions, and must not spend the owner's personal subscription quota while organization-billed API routes can serve.
